dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How bad is it up on the mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Well, you should wear more layers for starters, or you might freeze.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Quite a few of my colleagues haven't dared to come back after making just one trip here.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Hmm? You want to know why I don't fear the cold?

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Well, it's because of my indomitable will and my frigidity-proof physique... and the three or four layers that I'm wearing under this armor. Those are keeping me very warm indeed.
